settings.activity.title: My activity
settings.activity.desc: Write actions you take on this site are recorded here — catalog edits, account changes, forum posts and uploads. Only your own records are shown; reads are never logged.
settings.activity.completeness: This log is not a complete ledger, for two reasons. Auditing is written on a side channel, so rows can be dropped — and are never backfilled — if the write queue is full or the insert fails. And change summaries are redacted and truncated (passwords, tokens and email addresses are never stored). For the full before/after of a catalog edit, open that entity's revision history.

admin.exchange.errNotFound: The entity does not exist, or you do not have permission to view it (404 not_found).
admin.exchange.errInvalidPayload: The request body could not be parsed (400 invalid_payload): malformed JSON, an unknown field, or over the 2 MiB limit.
admin.exchange.errEvidenceRequired: The server requires an edit note and at least one source (400 evidence_required) — complete them and retry.
admin.exchange.errInvalidSource: Invalid source (400 invalid_source): kind must be url, publication or self, citation is required, and a non-empty url must be a valid http(s) link.

admin.exchange.errConstraintViolation: A database constraint was violated (400 constraint_violation): a referenced parent, release or expression is missing, belongs elsewhere, or a position is duplicated.
admin.exchange.errInvalidId: Invalid id format (400 invalid_id): an entity id must be a uuid.
